## Semlink 2.0.0

A major release focused on embedding-provider coverage, RAG dashboard accuracy, and a smoother embedding guide.

### New

- **Dedicated embedding provider catalog**: SiliconFlow, Jina, Voyage AI, Nomic, Mixedbread, Perplexity and more, with representative embedding models and per-provider setup (keys links, endpoint conventions).
- **Embedding path override** (`embedPath`) for providers whose embeddings endpoint deviates from the OpenAI-compatible default, plus support for key-less local runtimes such as Ollama.
- **Reconfigure** action on the embedding guide's index step: jump straight back to model setup, and when the key is re-validated with a different model, a full re-index starts automatically.
- **Index / auto-embed toggles** on the RAG progress panel headers. Pausing or resuming indexing and turning embedding off takes effect immediately — even mid-run — without restarting the scheduler.
- Opening Settings re-checks the total note count, so the dashboard no longer shows 0 after a progress reset.
- Home button in the sidebar that doubles as a guide entry (no conversation yet) or a back-to-home action (mid conversation).

### Fixes

- The "embedded" count on the RAG dashboard and the embedding guide now reports real per-note embedding progress. A document-vector storage bug (swapped SQL column bindings) that inflated counts and silently disabled related-notes search is fixed; affected data is rebuilt automatically on first load.
- Fixed a crash on the embedding guide's index step ("Cannot access before initialization") that left the pause/finish button unresponsive.
- Long note names no longer push the chunk progress out of view on the guide's index step; the name truncates instead.
- The pour animation in the embedding guide now keeps flowing while chunks are processing, not just when a new note starts.
- Tool glob matching now covers path separators, so `*keyword*` matches files in subfolders; oversized tool outputs are shrunk line-by-line while staying valid JSON with explicit truncation markers.
- The LAN share page now opens via the actual LAN address instead of 127.0.0.1.

### Changes

- Quieter notifications: no more toasts when the MCP server starts or when an index run starts / is already running.
- The standalone "Auto index" row moved into the index panel toggle; the standalone re-embed button was removed (changing the embedding model or using Reconfigure covers it); "Re-index" is now the last row under advanced options.
- Release notes, versions and packaging updated for the 2.0.0 line.
